<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 460" font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0d1117"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#161b22"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="agent" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#512BD4"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7c4dff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.5" result="b"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
    <style>
      .lbl{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:3px;fill:#8b949e;font-weight:600}
      .src-t{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;fill:#e6edf3}
      .src-s{font-size:10px;fill:#7d8590;font-family:'Consolas',monospace}
      .head{font-size:34px;font-weight:800;fill:#e6edf3}
      .headi{font-size:34px;font-weight:800;font-style:italic;fill:#512BD4}
      .dash{stroke:#30363d;stroke-width:2;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:6 6}
      .flow{stroke:#7c4dff;stroke-width:2;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:4 10;stroke-linecap:round}
      .dot{fill:#7c4dff}
      @keyframes dashmove{to{stroke-dashoffset:-140}}
      .flow{animation:dashmove 3s linear infinite}
      @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.4}50%{opacity:1}}
      .pdot{animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
      @keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
      .agent{animation:bob 3s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:center}
    </style>
  </defs>

  <rect width="900" height="460" rx="16" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect x="1" y="1" width="898" height="458" rx="15" fill="none" stroke="#21262d"/>

  <!-- top labels -->
  <text x="40" y="34" class="lbl">STACK · LIVE</text>
  <text x="450" y="34" class="lbl" text-anchor="middle">INCREMENTAL · SYNC</text>
  <text x="860" y="34" class="lbl" text-anchor="end">AGENT · SHIP</text>

  <!-- source cards -->
  <g>
    <g transform="translate(40,60)">
      <rect width="230" height="46" rx="9" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/>
      <rect width="4" height="46" rx="2" fill="#239120"/>
      <text x="20" y="21" class="src-t">C# / .NET</text>
      <text x="20" y="37" class="src-s">Program.cs · build · now</text>
      <circle cx="212" cy="23" r="4" class="dot pdot"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(40,116)">
      <rect width="230" height="46" rx="9" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/>
      <rect width="4" height="46" rx="2" fill="#512BD4"/>
      <text x="20" y="21" class="src-t">ASP.NET Core</text>
      <text x="20" y="37" class="src-s">/api · REST · 2m</text>
      <circle cx="212" cy="23" r="4" class="dot pdot" style="animation-delay:.4s"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(40,172)">
      <rect width="230" height="46" rx="9" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/>
      <rect width="4" height="46" rx="2" fill="#CC2927"/>
      <text x="20" y="21" class="src-t">SQL Server · PostgreSQL</text>
      <text x="20" y="37" class="src-s">migrations · 5m</text>
      <circle cx="212" cy="23" r="4" class="dot pdot" style="animation-delay:.8s"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(40,228)">
      <rect width="230" height="46" rx="9" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/>
      <rect width="4" height="46" rx="2" fill="#2496ED"/>
      <text x="20" y="21" class="src-t">Docker · Azure</text>
      <text x="20" y="37" class="src-s">deploy · cloud · 8m</text>
      <circle cx="212" cy="23" r="4" class="dot pdot" style="animation-delay:1.2s"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- dashed connectors to hub -->
  <path class="dash" d="M270 83 C330 83 360 160 410 170"/>
  <path class="dash" d="M270 139 C330 139 370 165 410 172"/>
  <path class="dash" d="M270 195 C330 195 370 180 410 176"/>
  <path class="dash" d="M270 251 C330 251 360 190 410 182"/>

  <!-- hub -->
  <g transform="translate(410,140)">
    <circle cx="35" cy="35" r="34" fill="#161b22" stroke="#512BD4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="35" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22">⚙️</text>
    <text x="35" y="48" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#7c4dff" font-weight="700">.NET</text>
    <text x="35" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" class="lbl">ALWAYS · ON</text>
  </g>

  <!-- flow to agent -->
  <path class="flow" d="M480 175 C560 175 590 150 640 150"/>

  <!-- agent -->
  <g class="agent" transform="translate(640,110)">
    <rect x="0" y="10" width="80" height="66" rx="12" fill="url(#agent)" filter="url(#glow)"/>
    <rect x="14" y="26" width="52" height="30" rx="6" fill="#0d1117"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="41" r="5" fill="#7c4dff"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="41" r="5" fill="#7c4dff"/>
    <rect x="36" y="0" width="8" height="12" rx="3" fill="#7c4dff"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="2" r="4" fill="#7c4dff"/>
    <text x="40" y="94" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">SHIP AGENT</text>
  </g>

  <!-- context panel -->
  <g transform="translate(750,55)">
    <rect width="118" height="150" rx="10" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/>
    <text x="12" y="22" font-size="9" letter-spacing="2" fill="#8b949e" font-weight="700">CONTEXT · FRESH</text>
    <rect x="12" y="34" width="94" height="6" rx="3" fill="#21262d"/><rect x="12" y="34" width="70" height="6" rx="3" fill="#239120"/>
    <rect x="12" y="50" width="94" height="6" rx="3" fill="#21262d"/><rect x="12" y="50" width="50" height="6" rx="3" fill="#512BD4"/>
    <rect x="12" y="66" width="94" height="6" rx="3" fill="#21262d"/><rect x="12" y="66" width="84" height="6" rx="3" fill="#CC2927"/>
    <rect x="12" y="82" width="94" height="6" rx="3" fill="#21262d"/><rect x="12" y="82" width="40" height="6" rx="3" fill="#2496ED"/>
    <circle cx="16" cy="106" r="3" class="dot pdot"/>
    <text x="26" y="110" font-size="9" fill="#7d8590">clean architecture</text>
    <text x="12" y="132" font-size="8" fill="#7d8590" font-family="Consolas,monospace">99.9% · on-ship</text>
  </g>

  <!-- divider -->
  <line x1="40" y1="300" x2="860" y2="300" stroke="#21262d"/>

  <!-- headline -->
  <text x="450" y="345" text-anchor="middle"><tspan class="head">Your APIs deserve </tspan><tspan class="headi">clean context.</tspan></text>

  <!-- sub -->
  <text x="450" y="378" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#8b949e">Amjad Youssef — .NET Developer · scalable, efficient, always-on</text>

  <!-- feature chips -->
  <g font-size="11" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">
    <g transform="translate(230,400)"><rect x="-70" y="0" width="140" height="24" rx="12" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/><text y="16" fill="#7c4dff">Microservices</text></g>
    <g transform="translate(390,400)"><rect x="-70" y="0" width="140" height="24" rx="12" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/><text y="16" fill="#239120">Clean Architecture</text></g>
    <g transform="translate(560,400)"><rect x="-75" y="0" width="150" height="24" rx="12" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/><text y="16" fill="#2496ED">Cloud-native · Azure</text></g>
    <g transform="translate(710,400)"><rect x="-55" y="0" width="110" height="24" rx="12" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/><text y="16" fill="#CC2927">RESTful APIs</text></g>
  </g>

  <text x="450" y="446" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#484f58" font-style="italic">"Clean code always looks like it was written by someone who cares." — Robert C. Martin</text>
</svg>
